groups.instructions: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

questions.prompt: About ________ per cent of daily actions may be habitual.
With habits, control moves to the ________ ganglia.
UCL study: average of ________ days to become automatic.
Missing one ________ did not significantly harm progress.
questions.explanation: 'missing a single day didn't significantly affect the process'.

questions.prompt: Linking a new behaviour to an old one is called habit ________.
Keep fruit on the table so it is more ________.
To break a habit, keep the cue and reward but change the ________.
People who had just moved were more likely to use public ________.
Governments should target messages at people in ________.
questions.explanation: 'targeting messages at people going through these transitions'.

groups.strategy: Lectures follow a clear structure. Notice signposts like 'So how can we…', 'Another strategy…', 'Finally…' to keep your place.
